_help: Base genres. A genre is the one part that needs real code: 'scene' is the Phaser scene that plays it. description: shown at the machine. levels: what level 2 and 3 add, picked at the machine like twist levels. Each level keeps what the levels below it gave. payout: multiplies the stage tokens on a win (shown as its own line, like a twist's). powerUp: one pickup per stage (platformer: double-jump, shmup: spread-shot, brawler: power-fists). boss: true puts a boss at the end of the run's last stage. New enemies and pieces come from the chunks, waves and arenas tagged { minLevel: 2 } (see chunks.js).
